links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of variant summaries with curated-database grounding versus web-search grounding
links.effect: Precision Grounding outperformed web-search grounding, with significantly higher accuracy (4.76, +0.74) and completeness (4.94, +0.84) on 5-point Likert scale; fewer clinically significant hallucinations.
links.quote: Precision Grounding outperformed web-search grounding, achieving significantly higher accuracy and completeness scores, which were based on a 5-point Likert-Scale of 4.76 (+0.74) and 4.94 (+0.84), respectively.
